client: I've been feeling really lost since my sister passed away six months ago. It's like I can't enjoy anything anymore, and I constantly feel this guilt for even thinking about moving on with my life. I sometimes wonder if therapy can really help me through this, or if I'm just going to be stuck in this pain forever.
therapist: I'm really sorry to hear how lost you've been feeling since your sister's passing. It sounds incredibly heavy to carry that guilt while trying to figure out how to move forward. It’s understandable to have doubts about therapy, especially when the pain feels so overwhelming, but it can be a space to explore those feelings and find a way to honor your sister while also allowing yourself to heal. You deserve support on this journey.
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, soft-spoken, moderate-paced speech
